howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
MEGA MILLIONS
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the numbers for you, or select your own six numbers:

5 white balls (1 – 70)
1 Mega Ball number (1 – 24)
Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Mega Millions tickets cost $5 per game and can be purchased** at more than 3,500 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the numbers on your ticket to the winning numbers*** selected to see if you won!
